name: Super-NeRF
definition: A method for NeRF super-resolution that generates plausible 3D consistent high-resolution (HR) details based on low-resolution (LR) observations only, without relying on HR ground truth. It uses a Consistency Controlling Super Resolution (CCSR) module and mutual learning between an LR NeRF and an HR NeRF.
summary: Super-NeRF is a NeRF super-resolution method that generates high-resolution details from low-resolution observations by coupling a NeRF with a GAN-based 2D super-resolution backbone and per-view latent codes.
